verdict.rationale: Jira is an issue-tracking and project-management product. It does not author or host commits, so requiring AI-authored commits to be signed with SSH or GPG keys falls outside its category; that belongs to source-control hosts or coding agents. The evidence shows only integrations that display development status (e.g., Bitbucket) and Rovo AI for task and automation work, with nothing indicating Jira itself creates commits.
